sections.en: 1-2 καὶ πρὸς πᾶσαν πρᾶξιν suppl. 2-3 φυτεύειν - ἐπιμελεῖσθαι, which the codex exhibits after εὑρεθήσεται, we have transposed here. τὰ κατ’ οἶκον cod., we τῶν κατ’ οἶκον. 3 εὐτυχῆ cod. 4 Words corrupt, noted by sigla (ἥμισυ ἡμέρας). 8 ποιοῦντ<α> cod. 10 παρατηρήσιμαι cod., we wrote παρατηρήσιμοι. 11 τοῦ Μαζουνατῆ cod., cf. above, p. 118, n. 1. 12 Perhaps read ὄνομα for ὀνόματι. 13 cod. everywhere ἕτερον which I corrected. 14 τάραξιν suppl. Should it be read αὗται? λέγουσιν cod., we wrote λέγονται. 15 ἡμέραν cod. we enclosed in brackets. 16 ὅτι ἡ ☿ ς το ☿ (?), in which what lies hidden we do not know. Or ἡ ἑκκαιδεκάτη ἡμέρα? 17 Should it be read ταύτης δὲ τὰ ὄπισθεν etc.? 20 ἡμέρας cod. 25 The last syllable in Τέμπελις written by abbreviation is uncertain. 27 The second letter in the word Ἀνολώστας is uncertain; for the paper is corroded.

summary.headline: Persian Star Omens by Month
summary.text: Astrological instructions for auspicious and inauspicious activities on the 29th and 30th lunar days, followed by a monthly list of Persian star omens causing disturbances, danger, rainstorms, winds, or fires from January through June. Named stars include Gampinēs, Lampēs, Sarēs, Saritze, Garar, Simel, Bekleus, Garphas, Tempelis, and Anolōstas; the apparatus cites Zanatē and related codices.
